title: ALMA 3 mm polarimetry of radio-quiet active galactic nuclei
question: What is the physical origin (X-ray corona, scaled-down jet, or outflow-driven shocks) of the compact millimeter emission in radio-quiet active galactic nuclei, as tested via millimeter polarimetry?

data.sensitivity: rms I: 0.007–0.016 mJy/beam; rms Q, U: 0.007–0.013 mJy/beam

what.value: X-ray flux normalization for Compton-thick AGN NGC 4945

evidence.quote: For the Compton-thick AGN NGC 4945, the intrinsic X-ray luminosity was calculated assuming that only the flux normalization varied, using the normalization from (cite: ricci17a).

what.value: High-resolution radio flux densities from 0.843 to 36 GHz for NGC 3783, MCG 5-23-16, and NGC 4945

evidence.loc: The size of the emitting region
evidence.quote: To address this, we compiled high-resolution radio data from the literature (Fig. 12, see details in Appendix 8).

external_data.citation: (cite: sumss; nvss; Unger87; Ulvestad84; Morganti99; Schmitt01; Orienti10; magno24; burlon13; CRATES; Elmouttie97; Roy10; McConnell12; mccarthy18; lenc09)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image Stokes I, Q, U, V maps
recipe.method: Run ALMA calibration pipeline and image Stokes I, Q, U, V parameters for each epoch using CASA tclean with Briggs weighting (robust=0.5)

recipe.goal: Measure polarized intensity, polarization degree, and upper limits
recipe.method: Compute polarized intensity P = sqrt(Q^2 + U^2), debiased polarization degree PD = P/I * 100%, and 3-sigma upper limits PD_lim at peak total intensity I when undetected

recipe.goal: Calculate in-band spectral index and spectral index maps
recipe.method: Fit a power law F_nu proportional to nu^alpha across the four spectral windows for the AGN core and pixel-by-pixel for pixels exceeding 2 sigma in all four spectral windows
key_parameters: 2 sigma threshold across all four spectral windows for spectral index mapping
assumptions: Power-law spectrum F_nu proportional to nu^alpha

recipe.goal: Analyze intra-observation and multi-epoch mm flux variability
recipe.method: Re-image observations in time intervals of tens of minutes to test intra-observation variability, and compare multi-epoch Band 3 fluxes and spectral indices using archival ALMA data with resolution < 0.3''
key_parameters: Angular resolution < 0.3'' for archival Band 3 data

recipe.goal: Estimate synchrotron emitting region sizes (R_min, R_max) and equipartition magnetic fields
recipe.method: Use Laor & Behar (2008) equipartition relations with 100 GHz luminosities to derive R_min and B_eq, and fit power laws to archival low-frequency radio data (<40 GHz) to estimate R_max from the highest frequency following the radio power law
assumptions: Homogeneous synchrotron source with uniform magnetic field in equipartition with photon energy density (B = B_eq)

recipe.goal: Compare RQ AGN polarization with archival ALMA observations of RL AGN
recipe.method: Examine archival high-resolution (<0.5'') ALMA polarization and multi-band continuum data for non-blazar RL AGN (NGC 1052, 3C 120, Cen A, M87) and FSRQ 3C 273
assumptions: Calibration uncertainty of 0.1% for archival polarization limits
